anomalies.expected: These are the serial-servo bridge jumpers, which the specification defines as 0 Ω and which the on-sheet note explicitly says must be shorted: 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo' / 'R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus'. No 4 kΩ value appears anywhere in the design (the resistor set is 0 Ω, 1 kΩ, 2.2 kΩ, 5.1 kΩ, 10 kΩ, 20 kΩ, 47 kΩ).

anomalies.impact: In serial-servo mode the two signal pins are not low-ohm bridged to the MAX3485 bus; a 4 kΩ series element in the shared TTL line heavily attenuates the half-duplex signal, so the RS-485 transceiver cannot reliably drive/read the serial servos. In PWM mode the same position is also wrong (4 kΩ instead of the intended 1 kΩ series buffer), degrading the servo signal edges.
